document.abstract: With the adoption of file-based workflows, interest in digital archiving has grown significantly in 2011. The broader information technology community has well-established standards and practices for digital archiving, which should be considered by the media industry. Current hot topics in digital archiving of media, including SMPTE standards efforts, are reviewed.
